faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about crypto taxes

items.question: Which exchanges and wallets are supported?
items.answer: We support over 20+ leading crypto exchanges, including Binance, Coinbase, Kraken, Bitpanda, Bitstamp and many more. Additionally, you can connect wallets like Ledger, MetaMask and Trust Wallet. CSV import from any platform possible.

items.question: Is CryptoTax compliant with German tax law?
items.answer: Yes, CryptoTax was specifically developed for German tax law. We use the FIFO method (First-In-First-Out) and consider the 1-year holding period for private sales transactions according to § 23 EStG.

items.question: How does the tax report work?
items.answer: 1) Import your transactions from exchanges/wallets, 2) CryptoTax automatically calculates gains, losses and holding periods, 3) Generate your official PDF report for the tax office. The complete process takes just a few minutes.

items.question: What happens to my data?
items.answer: Your data is protected by bank-level encryption (AES-256) and stored on German servers (GDPR compliant). We don't sell data and don't share it with third parties. You can export or delete your data at any time.

items.question: Are DeFi, Staking and NFTs supported?
items.answer: Yes! The Pro Report supports DeFi transactions (Uniswap, Aave, etc.), staking rewards, liquidity mining, NFT purchases/sales and mining. All earnings are correctly recorded for tax purposes and documented in the report.

items.question: Can I give the report to my tax advisor?
items.answer: Absolutely! The report is specially formatted for tax advisors and contains all necessary details: transaction list, profit/loss calculation, holding periods and tax assessment. Many tax advisors already work with CryptoTax. With the Pro Report, you can also share access directly with your tax advisor.

items.question: Can I create reports for previous years?
items.answer: Yes, you can create reports for all tax years from 2022 onwards. The Pro Report even supports loss carryforwards over multiple tax years - important for your tax optimization and carrying forward losses.

items.question: Is the software really free?
items.answer: You can use the software for free with limited features: import transactions, view tax calculations and test the platform. For the official, legally secure PDF tax report for the tax office, you pay once per report: Basic Report €29 (up to 250 transactions) or Pro Report €79 (unlimited transactions + advanced features like DeFi, NFTs, Staking).

items.question: What's the difference between Basic and Pro Report?
items.answer:
Basic Report (€29): Up to 250 transactions, simple tax report, PDF export, all tax methods.

Pro Report (€79): Unlimited transactions, DeFi & NFT support, staking rewards, tax advisor sharing, CSV/Excel export, loss carryforwards, priority support.

items.question: Is there an Enterprise plan for tax advisors?
items.answer: Yes! For €1,499/year you get: Unlimited reports for all clients, white-label branding, full API integration, bulk processing, centralized client dashboard and dedicated support. Contact our sales team for details.
